decisionsTitle: The club's identity lives in club/club.json, read at build time
decisionsSection:
**The owner (2026-11-01):** «we should make an effort to have the entire app white-labeled cuz I might want to reuse this repo for another run club».

This is the first of seven chains in the judged plan: the club's identity moves into one committed folder, with Brașov's values copied character for character and nothing a person sees changed.

**Decision.** The club's identity is `club/club.json`, committed and read at build time: the name, the slug (`brasovrunners`), the short mark (`BVR`), the wordmark, the public list's short forms (§753, §756), the place — city, county, plate code, country, the country's name in both languages, the time zone and its words as the emails say them («ora României» / "Romanian time"), the coordinates the sunset is read for (§394, §428), an identity card example —, the hashtags the calendar picture prints, the safety form's name, the logo files and their proportions. Beside it, `club/guard-words.json` holds the guard words the literal check refuses — the club's places and programmes (Tâmpa, Livada Poștei, Girl Zone…) — read by that check alone and imported by nothing under `src/` or `scripts/`. **This amends §369**: «the one place the name is written» is now `club/club.json`, read through `theme/brand.ts`.

- **One way in.** `src/club/config.ts` is the only importer of the file (the `@club/*` alias in `tsconfig.json` and the three Vitest configurations; Turbopack resolves it outside `src/`), and only `theme/brand.ts`, `events/domain/place.ts`, `i18n/dates.ts`, `events/domain/sun.ts` and `shared/config/env.ts` import it (`tests/unit/club/import-surface.test.ts`). Those five **only gain exports** — `CLUB_SLUG`, `CLUB_SHORT_NAME`, `CLUB_HASHTAGS`, `SAFETY_PROGRAMME`, `SITE_TITLE` (brand), `HOME_COUNTRY`, `HOME_COUNTRY_NAME`, `CLUB_COUNTY`, `CLUB_COUNTY_CODE`, `ID_DOCUMENT_EXAMPLE` (place), `ZONE_WORDS` (dates) — so the ~54 `CLUB_NAME` and ~111 `CLUB_TIME_ZONE` call sites read the names they read before; one, the page title in `app/[locale]/layout.tsx`, now reads `SITE_TITLE`, which renders the same «%s · {club}». `CLUB_SHORT_FORMS` is folded from the file; `env.ts` no longer imports the theme, and its `EMAIL_FROM_NAME` and `CLUB_COORDINATES` defaults come from the file.
- **JSON, not TypeScript,** so a plain `.mjs` script reads it without `tsx`. **No Zod and no environment in `src/club/`**: the theme brings the config into every public client island (§489, `public-islands-weight.test.ts`). The types come from `satisfies`; what a schema would check — a zone `Intl` knows, coordinates in range, every `{ro, en}` pair complete, a slug of `[a-z0-9-]`, logo viewBoxes equal to the SVGs' — is `tests/unit/club/club-config.test.ts`. The one runtime check is the country: **the region stays Romania** — `country` is typed `"RO"`, the languages `ro` and `en`, the legal texts Romanian law, the prices RON.
- **The guard words are a file of their own.** The bundler carries `club.json` whole into every public page's scripts — the theme imports `brand.ts`, which reads it — so nothing a visitor's browser should not receive goes in it. A first version kept the guard words in `club.json` and dropped them from `CLUB` at runtime; a production build still shipped the whole file, the list included, in a `.next/static` chunk. Now `club/guard-words.json` is read by `club-literals.test.ts` alone, `import-surface.test.ts` fails on any import of it from `src/` or `scripts/`, and `club-config.test.ts` fails on a `club.json` key the schema does not name, so a `guardWords` written back fails the commit. The build's static files hold none of the list (no «Livada Poștei», no «Tâmpa»); «Girl Zone» is there once, as `safetyProgramme` — a public form's name, which the contact page prints anyway.
- **The zone's words are the emails'.** `ZONE_WORDS` («ora României» / "Romanian time") is the zone as the legal texts' digest email and the editor's zone summary say it; nothing reads it yet. The signed PDF's proof lines and «Sarcini»'s stalled-email row say "Romania time" in English: a later change that wires the zone's words there gives them that form of their own, so no line a signer compares with another copy changes.
- **The literal sites read the config** and render the same string for Brașov: `same-place.ts` builds its address parts from the city, the county and the plate code (no `judetul ${CITY}`); the public list's filler words take the country from the file; the glossary's context, the JSON-LD's `addressCountry`, the iCal `PRODID`, a test registration's city and country, the export's `EVENT_FILE_FORMAT` (`${slug}-event`, byte-identical), the Instagram example; about twenty `"RO"` literals that meant the club's country are `HOME_COUNTRY` (never a country table nor a language code); no `Europe/Bucharest` is left in `src/` but the `events.timezone` column's default, which stays; the seeds' dates use a signed offset and `CLUB_TIME_ZONE` (`atClubTime`, `atBrasov` its alias).
- **Guards.** `tests/unit/club/club-literals.test.ts` builds its forbidden words from the config (the folded name with optional separators, the wordmark, the slug, the short mark and nicknames as whole words, the city, the county, the ID example, the hashtags, the guard words of `club/guard-words.json`) and scans the strings of `src/` and `scripts/`, both catalogues, the workflows, `package.json` and `docker-compose.yml`; what is still written today is `known-leaks.ts`, a ratchet that counts the strings per file and per word, so it fails on a new string even in a listed file (a new message that says the name is seen) and on a count that is too high. It takes over the two §369 scans of `no-hardcoded-values.test.ts`, whose pins stay. A file snapshot pins every identity, place, time and logo value to what `origin/qa` printed, and `filled-hash-parity.test.ts` pins the seven legal templates' filled hashes in both languages, so no template is announced as newer (§639). `yarn test:fork` (`vitest.fork.config.mts`, a step of CI's `checks` job) builds the identity from a made-up club in Cluj-Napoca on the Azores' clock and finds none of this club's words in the title, the calendar, the JSON-LD, the From line, the glossary, the place and list matchers, a test registration, the export file, a blank draft or a seeded date.

**Refused.** A TypeScript config (scripts could not read it); Zod in `src/club/` (it would ship to every visitor); renaming any export or touching the call sites (a diff of hundreds of lines for no visible change); the guard words inside `club.json` (the bundler ships that file to every browser); moving the palette, the mountains drawing, the legal clauses and the catalogues' wording in the same change (later changes — their literals are listed in `known-leaks.ts`); changing the `events.timezone` column's default (a migration for nothing); a country other than Romania.
changelogLine: - **The club's identity in one file** — `club/club.json` holds the name, slug, short mark, place, time zone, coordinates, hashtags and logo files, read at build time through `brand.ts`, `place.ts`, `dates.ts`, `sun.ts` and `env.ts`; nothing a visitor sees changed, a literal-word guard and `yarn test:fork` keep it that way. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the club's identity, then it is read at build time from `club/club.json` through `src/club/config.ts` alone, which only `theme/brand.ts`, `events/domain/place.ts`, `i18n/dates.ts`, `events/domain/sun.ts` and `shared/config/env.ts` import and which carries neither Zod nor the environment; the guard words are `club/guard-words.json`, which nothing under `src/` or `scripts/` imports and whose list no production bundle carries; the file names a zone `Intl` knows, the country `RO`, coordinates in range, every bilingual text in both languages, a `[a-z0-9-]` slug and the logo's own viewBoxes (`tests/unit/club/club-config.test.ts`, `import-surface.test.ts`), and every identity, place, time and logo value and the seven legal templates' filled hashes equal what they were before the move (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `src/`, `scripts/`, both catalogues, the workflows, `package.json` and `docker-compose.yml`, then no string names a word built from `club/club.json` (the name glued or apart, the wordmark, the slug, the short mark, the city, the county, the ID example, the hashtags, the guard words of `club/guard-words.json`) beyond the ratchet `tests/unit/club/known-leaks.ts`, which fails on a new leak and on a stale entry; and `yarn test:fork`, with `@club` pointed at a made-up club, renders the page title, the calendar's product id and feed name, the JSON-LD, the From default, the glossary, the place and public-list matchers, a test registration, the export file id, a blank draft's zone and a seeded date with that club's words and none of this club's (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the club's identity read from club/club.json
